audience: developers who run background tasks on Trigger.dev

useCases.title: Find failed runs and read their errors
useCases.text: The AI lists runs filtered by status, task, tag, queue or time window, then opens a run to read its output, error and attempts.

useCases.title: Find where a run spent its time or broke
useCases.text: The AI reads the full trace of a run with every span and its timing, one span with its logs, and the lifecycle events (queued, started, retried, completed).

useCases.title: Check queues that are backing up
useCases.text: The AI lists queues with their concurrency limit, running count and queued count, so you see where work piles up.

useCases.title: Review cron schedules and their next runs
useCases.text: The AI lists schedules with cron expression, timezone, active state and next run times.

useCases.title: Pause or resume a schedule or a queue
useCases.text: The AI deactivates a schedule that misbehaves, activates it again later, or pauses a queue so its runs stop being dequeued.

useCases.title: Cancel, replay, reschedule or tag a run
useCases.text: The AI cancels a run in flight, replays a past run with the same payload, changes the time of a delayed run, or adds tags to a run.
